first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior onboarding simplification improved time-to-value and adoption without relying on discounts. I would verify the onboarding result and the competing promotional-pricing evidence before committing, since pricing pressure may warrant a different response if the onboarding lift does not translate into qualified revenue. Run a guarded test focused on reducing unnecessary steps while monitoring activation quality, qualified pipeline, retention proxies, and revenue—not completion alone.
